description_en: Modifies the information of an image search application instance
description_zh: 调用该接口修改以图搜图应用实例的信息
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual update-picture-search-app --app-instance-id 3e429560124b44b685095df81a270000 --name '新以图搜图' --description '以图搜图Demo2' --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePictureSearchApp

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call [QueryPictureSearchApps](206608) to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID。可调用[QueryPictureSearchApps](206608)查询
parameters.name: app_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the image search application instance. 

The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and cannot exceed 64 characters in length (each Chinese character counts as 2 characters)
parameters.help_zh:
以图搜图应用实例的名称。 

支持中文汉字、英文大小写、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不超过64个字符（一个中文汉字算2个字符）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the image search application instance.

The description can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and cannot exceed 1024 characters in length (each Chinese character counts as 2 characters)
parameters.help_zh:
以图搜图应用实例的描述信息。

支持中文汉字、英文大小写、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不超过1024个字符（一个中文汉字算2个字符）
parameters.name: description

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
ErrorMessage.example: Description is mandatory for this action.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
